newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria H1 retail sales fall 52 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria H1 retail sales fall 52 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Bulgarian retail sales in the first half of this year were a real 52 percent lower than a year earlier due to high year-on-year consumer price inflation,
BULGARIA RETAIL SALES JAN-JUNE JAN-MAY JAN-JUNE'96
Sales of foods in the first six months fell a real 47.7 percent year-on-year and sales of non-foods declined a real 54.7 percent.

Retail sales in June alone totalled 249 billion levs at current prices, a real 45.7 percent down from the same month last year. Sales of foods declined a real 40.6 percent year-on-year and non-food sales fell a real 48.7 percent .
But retail sales were a real 4.1 percent higher in June compared to May, mainly due to slowing consumer price inflation last month as financial stabilisation took hold, the NSI said.

Consumer prices rose 0.8 percent in June month-on-month against 5.6 percent in May. Cumulative inflation for the first six months of the year was 484.2 percent and year-on-year inflation last month was 1,526.7 percent. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
